modes.operator_message: Open the public Prompt Kit directly. Do not require Git, ZIP extraction, PowerShell, Python, or Termux for normal use.
Open the phone launcher in the system browser, then use the install or Add to Home Screen surface.
Use the repository-owned CMD. It owns safe clone or fast-forward behavior and serves the validated portable Prompt Kit on the stable loopback origin.

android_prerequisites: Install Termux from F-Droid when a real Android shell checkout is required.
modes.operator_message: Use a real checkout only when the user intends to edit, commit, push, inspect source locally, or run repository tooling. Before updating an existing checkout, prove canonical origin, a clean worktree, current branch main, and zero local-only commits; then fast-forward main only.
Treat ZIP as a point-in-time snapshot. It is not the preferred normal-use or Favorites-preserving update path.

guardrails: Do not tell a normal phone or browser user to clone the repository merely to use the Prompt Kit.
Do not tell a mobile GitHub-app user to hunt for or download web/prompt-kit/index.html as the primary access path.
Distinguish use/install intent from edit/commit/push intent before prescribing acquisition commands.

For existing editable checkouts, verify canonical origin, clean worktree, current branch main, and zero local-only commits before fetching and fast-forwarding; never reset, clean, force-push, or discard local work.
Do not claim Add to Home Screen, PWA installation, Termux, Git authentication, browser storage, or clipboard behavior succeeded without device observation.
Resolve the canonical website through this contract and harness/artifacts.v1.json instead of guessing an index.html path.
proof_ceiling: Static repository routing and documentation contract proof only. Device browser behavior, PWA installation, Termux/F-Droid availability, Git credentials, network reachability, local storage, clipboard behavior, and successful push require observed runtime proof.
